newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stock index hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stock index hits new high.

text.p: Qatar's stock market share index was propelled to an all-time high of 141.84 in the week to Thursday on the back of heavy demand, dealers said.

"This is quite unusual at this time of the year with the holiday season started and shows the interest that the (six- week-old) official Doha Securities Market has generated in stock dealing," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, assistant general manager for treasury and investments at the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ).
For the first time, the CBQ's 17-share index jumped more than three points from 138.51 points in the previous week.
"This came in the midst of active trading and most shares registered significant price rises, especially in the banking and insurance sectors," said Shakarchi.
A spokesman for the Doha Securities Market said he expected prices to rise further as "most Qatari shares were undervalued and their price earning ratio was good."

A total of 17,031 shares changed hands worth 4.19 million riyals ($1.15 million). Banks accounted for 1.65 million riyals, insurance 391,390 riyals, services 1.84 million and industrial stocks 295,825 riyals.
Blue-chip Qatar National Bank and Qatar Insurance shares were each 20 riyals higher, moving to 610 and 580 respectively and Qatar Navigation 15 riyals to 765.
The CBQ gained 15 riyals to 350 and Qatar Islamic Bank 12 riyals to 165. Doha Bank Ltd and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar added four riyals each to 330 and 290 respectively.
Al Khaleej Insurance advanced 10 riyals to 275 and Qatar Flour Mills 15 riyals to 330. Qatar Cement rose five riyals to 315 and Qatar Shipping picked up one riyal to 47. ($1=3.64 riyals)
